36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
88892: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series.
89028: Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero All Might. Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil.
89220: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero Endeavor. Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life.
89221: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily.
89222: Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously.
89223: Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.
89224: All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being.
89225: Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by Present Mic when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies.
89226: Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of All For One. He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing All Might, and ultimately destroying the society he represents.
89240: The U.S.J. Nomu is an Upper-Tier Nomu that appeared with the League of Villains and acted as one of the main antagonists of the U.S.J. Arc.
89241: Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader.
89242: Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time.
89243: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively.
89247: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering.
89248: Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies".
89249: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly Katsuki Bakugou.
89589: Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics.
89895: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk.
89896: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker.
89897: Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating.
89898: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless.
89899: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone.
89900: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things.
89901: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature.
89902: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes.
121529: Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size.
122560: Sirius is a pro hero and sidekick of Selkie.
123527: He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before Izuku Midoriya, Mirio was the top candidate for All Might's successor and inheritor of One For All.
125450: Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person.
125619: Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to Stain.
125934: Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences.
125951: Melissa is a Quirkless girl and the daughter of Scientist David Shield.
125952: David is a scientist who creates support items for heroes, and an old friend of All Might. He is the father of Melissa Shield.
125956: All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.
126005: Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad.
126064: Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct.
126067: Villain and former vigilante that was notorious for having killed many Pro Heroes. He attacks and kills heroes who he believes do not fit his definition of a "true hero." Chizome is a cruel, unforgiving, and merciless man with a sense of duty to cleanse society of false heroes.
126087: Koichi has an easy-going, mild-mannered personality. He is very generous and does not seem to expect anything from other people in return. He dreams of being able to become a recognized hero and is shown to enjoy the vigilante work that he does.
126093: Eri is a child with bandages all over her body. She wears a white short sleeve dress and has a small horn on the right side of her forehead and has white, long, choppy, unkempt hair. She also has red eyes. Under her bandages, her arms are shown to have numerous scars.
126158: Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows.
126319: Shimura Nana was the seventh user of the One For All Quirk, All Might's mentor, and a close friend of Gran Torino.
126357: Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai. Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon.
126378: Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious.
126734: Camie seems to be very talkative, especially when learning more about people who pique her interest. She was thrilled upon seeing Shoto Todoroki for the first time, delighted at the fact that she would both meet a handsome man as well as undergo training.
126843: She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving.
126855: Inasa is an energetic and enthusiastic young man who expresses himself with vigor. He's very loud, oddly polite, and values passion over anything else. Inasa believes that all heroes have "hot spirits" that enable them to motivate and help others.
127042: Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk.
127043: Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions.
127425: Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation.
127426: Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known.
127427: Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her.
127428: A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher.
128299: Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting.
129631: Knuckleduster is an individual with a strong sense of justice and drive to do the right thing.
129632: Pop☆Step is a very logical and intellectual person; she acts as the brains of the vigilantes. She appears to act like a more moderate tsundere, mocking and insulting her allies despite clearly caring for Koichi.
129755: In his fat form, Taishiro is a big round man, easily towering over other adults. In this form, his mouth is big, and his nose is smaller, which alongside his odd body proportions, give him an odd look.
129756: Manami is a short woman who wears an elaborate outfit with several heart motifs, such as heart-shaped earrings, belt buckles, and a bowtie.
129757: Tensei Iida, also known as Turbo Hero "Ingenium", is the older brother of Tenya Iida and a former Pro Hero. Outside of his hero armor Tensei looks much like his younger brother Tenya, with square features and short black spiked hair.
129758: Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask.
129759: Natsuo Todoroki is a college student. He is the son of Enji and Rei Todoroki, the younger brother of Toya and Fuyumi, and the older brother of Shoto. Natsuo is a young man of average height, sporting white spiky hair with two small pieces of hair hanging down by his forehead.
129760: Danjuro is a man with a refined appearance. He has a slicked back hairdo with a curl at the front. He sports a handlebar mustache along with a well-kept, medium-sized beard.
129761: A Pro Hero and Mirio Togata's mentor. He was formerly All Might's sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency. Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance.
129762: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat.
129765: Makoto Tsukauchi is Naomasa Tsukauchi's younger sister and a senior college student. She has a strong resemblance to her brother. Makoto is an intelligent, independent and studious woman who possess a strong determination towards her goals.
129766: Christopher Skyline, also known as Captain Celebrity, is the top-rank American hero in Illegals universe. He's a Caucasian man with a strong build. He has blonde hair and a sharp, chiseled jaw. Christopher is arrogant and a stereotypical celebrity.
131155: A second year student at Shiketsu High. His Quirk, "Meatball," allows him to roll all living flesh up into meatballs, as well as manipulate his own flesh to his liking. He can remotely control his own flesh after detaching it.
131157: A second year at Ketsubutsu Academy. His quirk, "Vibrate," allows him to create large tremors similar to earthquakes, but firing off strong attacks leaves him immobile.
133659: Kota Izumi is the nephew of Shino Sosaki and the son of the hero team Water Hose.
136897: Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.
137506: Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies.
141748: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry.
141749: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization
141893: With this Quirk, Kaoruko can make bubbles filled with an aroma that she had smelled at least once before. She can make both sweet-smelling bubbles and foul-smelling ones.
142169: Pro Hero and a teacher of 2nd year, Class 2 at Ketsubutsu Academy High School.
143275: Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy.
143535: Her Quirk allowed her to observe and monitor up to 100 people at a time, including their location and weak points.
143536: Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially.
143539: Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.
143540: Gigantomachia is a villain associated with the League of Villains.[1] He is one of All For One's faithful servants and his former bodyguard, cultivated to be of use to Tomura Shigaraki if anything were to happen to him.
143541: Ryuko Tsuchikawa also known as Pixie-Bob, is a Pro Hero and a member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. She is a very hyperactive and loud person with little regard for how she may come off to other people and also is very self-conscious about her age.
143542: Thirteen is a wise, well-mannered person. As a rescue hero, Thirteen has displayed how passionate they are about saving people through their teachings.
144523: One of the Eight Bullets who serves Overhaul and the Shie Hassaikai. Kendou is a very hot-blooded man who thrives on violence and bloodshed. He has a warrior-like mentality, and he only cares about seeking a battle that can satisfy him.
145291: When she activates her Quirk, her body transforms into that of a large, winged dragon with pale gray scales, although she still has the same skin tone, hair and eyes, and her hero costume remains visible bar her boots.
145292: Ken is a man of average height, with a darker complexion and dark, curly hair. He has pierced ears with padlocks in them. Notably, his fingertips have protrusions that resemble key teeth. Part of his hero costume is a small white mask that covers his eyes.
145387: Pony is a timid girl. As a foreigner, she does not have much knowledge of the language in Japan.
148023: A resident of Nabu Island and the younger brother of Mahoro. His Quirk is Cell Activation, which invigorates and restores damaged cells.
148024: A resident of Nabu Island, and the older sister of Katsuma. Her Quirk is the ability to conjure illusions.
148747: Daruma Ujiko is the pseudonym of a villain affiliated with the League of Villains, later the Paranormal Liberation Front. He is a faithful servant of All For One and later Tomura Shigaraki as well.
148982: Oboro was a man of average stature with light, wavy hair that was swept back to flow upwards above his head, two shorter, ear-length tufts left hanging downwards to frame his face.
148985: Rumi is the No. 5 Pro Hero. She has an athletic build with muscular arms and legs. She has dark skin, red eyes which are tilted slightly inwards, and straight white hair reaching down past her waist.
149178: Ryo Inui is a Pro Hero and serves as the Lifestyle Guidance Counselor at U.A. High School.
149179: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shouto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.
149180: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.
149182: Yui Kodai is a student in Class 1-B of U.A. High School. She is a quiet girl, but nevertheless cares about her fellow classmates.
149183: Juzo Honenuki is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being his fellow 1-B classmate Setsuna Tokage, the others being rival 1-A students Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.
149186: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.
149187: Death Arms is a Pro Hero. He took part in the fight against the Sludge Villain, and later witnessed the U.A. Sports Festival from outside the arena, along with Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods.
149188: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.
150627: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school.
150628: The damaged mother of the Todoroki family. Rei has an ice related quirk, which is believed to be powerful, as Eiji would not have had kids with her otherwise. In the past, Rei was very supportive towards Shouto and his dreams to become like All Might.
150853: Ectoplasm has the ability to produce ectoplasm from his mouth and transform it into clones of himself. He can create up to thirty clones at once, and push his limit to thirty-six if he's feeling good.
157655: Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish.
158615: Yokumiru Mera is a worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission. He suffers from sleep deprivation due to overwork, something that he complains about frequently.
160440: Chitose Kizuki, also known as Curious, is a journalist and a member of the Meta Liberation Army.
160442: Moe Kamiji, also known as her hero name Burnin, is a pro hero and one of over 30 sidekicks working at the Endeavor Hero Agency.
164355: Kaibara Sen is a student from 1-B. His quirk "Gyrate" allows Kaibara to rotate any part of his body.
188796: Gunhead is a pro hero. We meet him when Ochaco Uraraka does an internship at the Battle Hero's Office. Gunhead is a very professional individual whose kindness and friendliness makes him a great teacher. Despite his outward appearance he has cute tendencies such as posing cutely.
191595: Lunch Rush is a Pro Hero and the Chef at the cafeteria of U.A. High School. He is known for his good cooking.
191596: Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School.
208141: Shihai is a sly, deceitful schemer, who prefers to catch people off guard. He appears to enjoy dark concepts and has a penchant for dramatic speech
208145: Kousei is a very enthusiastic and competitive individual who holds himself to a high standard as he makes an effort to avoid descending to the level of his rivals.
208146: Manga appears to be an expressive and dramatic person. He is a regular man with a white speech bubble head that can change shape and display his thoughts in written form.
208147: Although he is not as social as some others, Yosetsu is foul-mouthed and tense, except for serious or life-or-death situations, in which he becomes very easily startled and much more talkative, although he retains his harsh way of speech.
208149: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.
210090: Can do pretty much everything a spotted seal can do. He can even make sonar-like sound and use the echo to determine his opponent's position. He is also very strong even if he believes that he can make a very cute seal face (which most people think is not).
225724: A villain who used to be a Pro Hero. Kaina Tsutsumi can protrude and retract a rifle from her right elbow, which she can fire bullets out of with a range of 3 kilometers.
226254: Rody is a very carefree individual who always looks for an opportunity/job to support his younger brother and sister and make their lives better. He is a smooth liar and a good negotiator, able to talk his way out of most situations.
231957: Mitsuki Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's mother and the wife of Masaru Bakugou.
239092: A villain working for Flect Turn. Her Quirk allows her to transform her left thumb and pinky finger into the two ends of an archery bow, allowing her to shoot projectiles with enough power to penetrate a car.
239093: A villain working for Flect Turn. His Quirk allows him to create and detach iron balls from his knuckles, which he can then enlarge in size and mass. He can detach them to provide ammo for Beros.
239094: A villain duo comprised of twin brothers Ena and Dio. They work for Flect Turn.
239095: A villain working for Flect Turn. Leviathan's Quirk allows him to lengthen and control the red appendages on his fingers and head. He can use these tendrils as a whip for a ranged attacks and they are powerful enough to pierce through things like a drill.
241582: Sansa is a member in the Police Force.
254779: Godzillo possesses a very dragon-like appearance, with a long tail and clawed paws for hands, although his head more closely resembles that of a bear. He is covered in dark gray scales and appears to be of quite a wide build, most prominently around his legs and torso.
254809: The current No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America. She is stated to be the strongest woman in the whole world. Cathleen's Quirk allows her to set a rule onto her surroundings, allowing her to manipulate and bestow new properties onto herself and the world around her.
283096: Backdraft is a pro hero. His quirk, Hydrokinesis, allows him to create and manipulate water through spigots that he has in place of hands. He is affiliated with Musutafu Fire Department
291608: The No. 1 Pro Hero in Egypt. He has a strange aura that makes the Egyptian citizens feel at ease when they see him fight, but to this day no one has ever seen his back. Salaam's Quirk Papyrus allows the user to flatten their body like papyrus.
291612: A villain working for Flect Turn. He is a somewhat slim man with long hair, red skin, sunken eyes and a thin moustache, however his Quirk allows him to transform into an Oni-like creature with immense physical strength.
291616: Pro Hero. During U.A. High School's Work Studies II, he takes in Creati and Lizardy. He is one of the heroes assigned to the Villa Raid Team led by Edgeshot.

360820: Leader of a trio of delinquents.
